purpose: Canonical factual knowledge library for the observable universe, Solar System, Earth, and Earth history. This is a knowledge substrate for Eira, not an authority bypass and not a claim of exhaustive knowledge.

record_contract.rule: Only accepted records may be represented by Eira as established factual memory. Other states remain queryable with their epistemic status exposed.

source_policy.current_events: News is time-stamped evidence of reporting, not automatic factual admission. Material claims require corroboration or a primary record when reasonably available.
source_policy.copyright: Archive open, public-domain, licensed, or user-authorized documents. Otherwise retain metadata, citations, permitted excerpts, and derived factual records rather than unauthorized full copies.

astronomy_contract.color_truth: Eira must distinguish measured spectral/filter data, scientific false-color mappings, and literal human-visible appearance.

storage_layers.source_archive: Immutable/versioned source documents and dataset metadata.
storage_layers.factual_graph: Truth-gated atomic claims with provenance and semantic relationships.
storage_layers.timeline: Deep-time, planetary, biological, and human historical events with uncertainty ranges.
storage_layers.equation_registry: Equations with symbols, units, assumptions, domains of validity, references, and executable solver bindings.
storage_layers.observation_archive: Astronomical and planetary observations plus processing provenance.
storage_layers.frontier: Unverified, contested, emerging, or hypothetical knowledge isolated from accepted facts.

anti_exhaustiveness_rule: The system may continuously expand coverage toward comprehensive knowledge but must never claim literal possession of everything. Coverage is measured and missing knowledge remains explicitly discoverable.

first_file_only.scope: Implement only the immutable knowledge-record schema and validation invariants. No fetching, no Truth Gate scoring, no ingestion, no model calls, no memory writes until this file reaches 50/50.
